blocks.text: Panorama Ridge: Established Estates in Surrey

parts.t: Panorama Ridge is an established, estate-oriented Surrey neighbourhood known for larger lots, mature properties, and executive homes — not a brand-new master-planned pocket built only in the last two decades. Buyers looking for space, privacy, and custom or larger residences often compare this area with nearby Surrey neighbourhoods when they want more land than a typical suburban subdivision.

Parks, green space, and the Panorama Recreation Centre support an active lifestyle, while Highway 15 and Highway 10 keep commuting practical across Surrey and the Fraser Valley. Reach out for current Panorama Ridge listings and recent sales if you want room to grow without leaving Surrey.
Can't find what you're looking for? Jared can search the full MLS® for you.
